title.narrative: Support to the Kyrgyz Republic for Water and Wastewater Investments, Phase 3

description.narrative: EBRD has established a sovereign investment Framework for water projects in secondary cities in the Kyrgyz Republic. The EBRD Framework is addressing the common problems in the water and wastewater sector in Kyrgyz Republic through a number of relatively small but well-designed projects. The approach aims at achieving maximum impact under existing affordability and public debt constraints in the country.
